channel.title: Santa Monica Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Santa Monica Daily Press (smdp.com)

item.title: Santa Monica Playhouse Presents 'Matty' March 28-29
item.description: Santa Monica Playhouse presents Eddie Frierson's acclaimed baseball show 'Matty' March 28-29, 2025. $25 tickets include post-show reception.

item.title: Irish Film Festival Returns to Santa Monica March 20-22
item.description: Irish Film Festival Los Angeles returns to Santa Monica's Laemmle Monica Film Center March 20-22, 2026 with 9 features, 30 shorts, and filmmaker Q&As.

item.title: Santa Monica Woman Turns Personal Grief Into AI Coaching Platform
item.description: Santa Monica grief coach Sarah Gwilliam launched Solace, the first AI grief coaching platform, after losing both parents. Offers 24/7 support.

item.title: SMMUSD Overhauls Immigration Enforcement Policies Ahead of State Deadline
item.description: Santa Monica-Malibu school district overhauls immigration enforcement policies, adding new protections for students and staff before state deadline.

item.title: Santa Monica Native Launches Literary Project to Preserve Pico Neighborhood's Vanishing Voices
item.description: Raquel 'Rocky' Perez launches community literary collection to document stories of Black, Brown, and immigrant families in Santa Monica's Pico neighborhood facing displacement from rising rents.

item.title: Professional Wheelchair Race Returns to ASICS Los Angeles Marathon on March 8
item.description: Elite wheelchair athletes compete in ASICS Los Angeles Marathon's Professional Wheelchair Division on March 8, 2026, starting at Dodger Stadium.

item.title: Santa Monica College Spring Jazz Series Opens March 6
item.description: Santa Monica College presents its Spring 2026 Friday Night Jazz Series starting March 6 with Bob Reynolds, featuring three concerts through May at SMC.

item.title: Downtown Santa Monica to Host St. Paddy's Day Celebration on Third Street Promenade
item.description: Free St. Patrick's Day celebration on Third Street Promenade in Santa Monica March 14, 2026, 6-9pm featuring live Irish music, games, and outdoor bar.

item.title: Newsletter: Mar 02, 2026
item.description: Yes, it's already March.. Mostly sunny. Winds SSW at 5 to 10 mph.Today: 🌤️ High 69° / Low 53°Tomorrow: 🌤️ High 66° / Low 54°First Up Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District headquarters where board members are reviewing new immigration enforcement policies

item.title: MSNOW Reporter Jacob Soboroff to Discuss New Book on Los Angeles Fires at Santa Monica Library
item.description: MSNBC reporter Jacob Soboroff discusses his book 'Firestorm' about the 2025 LA fires at Santa Monica Library March 4, 6pm. Free event, book required.
